---
name: research-protocol-mini
description: Draft a bounded research protocol artifact from approved evidence, analysis plans, and host-provided templates.
---

# Research protocol

1. Make the research question, population or setting, outcome, data
   limitation, and analysis assumption explicit in the structured draft.
2. Link only host-approved evidence bundles, templates, and analysis artifacts.
3. State gaps and governance dependencies rather than inventing eligibility
   criteria, endpoints, approvals, or data access.
4. Treat a draft as neither an ethics approval nor permission to query a real
   cohort. Validate it before delivery.
